reviews.body: Config nit that isn't a nit.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: First version read `os.environ["TOKENIZER_URL"]` here. Please add it to `Settings` instead: env reads scattered around app/ are invisible to the config docs, crash at import time in tests, and skip the PAYMENTS_ prefix we use in every deployment.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: The first commit queried `pm_repo.list_active` with a session right in the handler. Same thing as #104: handlers call a service, the service owns the session.

comments.author: frank
comments.body: Please add a docstring to `_with_display_details` explaining what it returns.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: It's a private helper and the name plus the type hints say it all. We document public service functions, not every underscore helper.

threads.rejection_reason: Private helpers are self-documenting by name; we only document public service functions.
